key_idea: Think of the unluckiest way: every marble that is not red comes out first.
steps: With bad luck, Ben gets every marble that is not red before a red one. Count those marbles.
First tube: 1 blue under the red. Second tube: a green and a blue under the red, so 2.
Third tube: 2 blue marbles and no red, so 2. Fourth tube: 1 green under the red.
1 + 2 + 2 + 1 = 6. After that, only red marbles can come out, so coin 7 must give a red marble.

choice_feedback.A: With bad luck, the first 6 marbles could all be blue or green.
choice_feedback.B: With bad luck, all 6 of those marbles are blue or green. One more coin is needed.
choice_feedback.D: 8 coins would work, but 7 are already enough to be sure.
choice_feedback.E: 10 coins would work, but 7 are already enough to be sure.
